$comment: Format presets for the {{CAPTURE_NAME}} capture. Not part of the engine lock (its schema has no formats key); skill tools and templates read this file. Screen formats are px-first; print formats are MILLIMETRE-first and their px values are derived quality targets only, never the geometry source. Story safe zones account for platform chrome. Stage print last: highest ink/scaling risk.

screen-4k.use: event screens (opening, agenda, speaker slides) on a 4K wall; build in px of this frame, RGB

a4-onepager.use: one-pager, handout; zero bleed is only valid while the template design avoids full-bleed art

a2-poster.use: large poster; 200 dpi is acceptable at A2 viewing distance — ink/scaling risk, stage last

badge.use: conference badge, portrait; check the holder window, hole/grommet zones and any stuck-on label zone before designing

lanyard-strip.use: sublimated lanyard, one strip per width (15/20/25 mm) plus a seamless repeat tile; see print-collateral §9

square-brochure.use: 4- or 8-page square booklet; pages imposed on 420 × 210 sheets; see multi-page-print

frame-banner.use: textile for a 1 × 2.5 m aluminium frame; hemmed, no marks; raster ≥ 100 dpi comfortable, flag < 60; see large-format-textile

photo-wall.use: photocall wall on a floor frame; lower 1.2 m is covered by people; raster ≥ 50 dpi, flag < 35

stage-backdrop.use: textile behind a centred lectern; the printer asks for a printed safety margin, not a bleed; nothing informational within 150 mm of the trim or in the lectern zone

shaped-panel.shape: trapezoid 550 top / 430 foot (example); page = bounding box + bleed, fill clipped to the shape grown by the bleed, cut path as a separate dieline PDF
shaped-panel.use: lectern front, shaped signs; see print-collateral §11

object-print-area.use: a stock tote bag's single-colour print area inside the maker's margins (example values); the file is the print area, not the object; see print-collateral §12
